name: dbt-open-lineage
description: Interactive dbt model lineage graph with dbt node-selection filtering.

dbt-open-lineage.projectRoot.description: Absolute path to the dbt project root (contains dbt_project.yml). Empty = auto-detect.

dbt-open-lineage.dbtPath.description: Absolute path to the dbt executable used by Compile, Run, Recompile, and state: selector resolution. Empty = resolve dbt from PATH.

dbt-open-lineage.columnLineage.inspectio.description: Optional dbt target dedicated to disposable column-lineage inspection. Missing, divergent, or unresolved persistent models are built with --empty only in this target. Never point this at production or a schema containing valuable relations.

dbt-open-lineage.columnLineage.autoBuild.description: When an inspection target is configured, automatically run zero-row dbt builds there for missing or schema-divergent models.

dbt-open-lineage.columnLineage.refreshCa.description: Refresh warehouse relation and column metadata with dbt docs generate in an isolated target path before calculating column lineage. This does not build models.

enumDescriptions: Use the column-lineage engine bundled inside the extension (no Python needed).

Use `colibri` from PATH (install with `pip install dbt-colibri`). Choose this if the bundled engine fails to launch, e.g. on locked-down Windows where antivirus or Mark-of-the-Web blocks the bundled executable.
dbt-open-lineage.columnLineage.engine.description: Which column-lineage engine to run. 'bundled' uses the executable shipped with the extension; 'colibri' runs pip-installed dbt-colibri from PATH instead.

dbt-open-lineage.ai.provider.description: AI CLI used by the ✨ gist button. Presets fill ai.command; choose 'custom' to set your own.

dbt-open-lineage.ai.command.description: Command template run to draft a gist. {prompt} is passed as a single argument (no shell).

scripts.build: npm run build:host && npm run build:webview
scripts.pretest:integration: npm run build && tsc test/integration/runTest.ts test/integration/open.test.ts --outDir out-test --rootDir test --module commonjs --target ES2022 --skipLibCheck --esModuleInterop
